additional_info.subject: RE: ID0458058-DC/Si-D/FR-[Null] OCPP Issue CRM:03098000109
additional_info.body:
Dear
Fatima-Zahra Sobrani
,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0458058
(please ignore the previous email object, as it referred to a wrong ticket number).
This ticket
0458058
has been created for issues to activate the Power Saving Mode on
ARTEA
chargers.
In order to activate the Power Saving Mode in our Sicharge D, it is necessary from OCPP Backend side to configure the parameter "
PowerSavingModeSchedule
".
This parameter has the format
hh:mm|hh:mm,
start time and end time in local time.
If empty, no schedule is defined. If the start time equals the end time, the reactive power mode is active the entire time. The time is configured in the 24 hour format.
The parameter "
IsPowerSavingModeActive
" is a ReadOnly parameter, and indicates the current Power saving mode state.
I had a quick look at the first chargers in the list that you provided, and:
Charger
MP / P3 170000442
is configured correctly. The "
PowerSavingModeSchedule
" parameter has start time equal to end time, hence it is active all day long:
"PowerSavingModeSchedule": {
"readonly": false,
"value": "18:25|18:25"
From SCB I can see that it is currently active and working. For example right now an EV just connected, hence the charger is exiting the Power Saving Mode
2025-10-30T13:08:37.689164+00:00 [FW080005G1] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [CGR] OperationMode "POWER_SAVE" --> "CLOSE_MAINBREAKER"
The other #5 chargers on top of the list have the "
PowerSavingModeSchedule
" parameter empty, hence the Power Saving Mode is not active:
"PowerSavingModeSchedule": {
"readonly": false,
"value": ""
The configuration of the
PowerSavingModeSchedule
parameter has to be done from the OCPP Backend for each charger. Unfortunately, this cannot be done from our side as we do not have the access to Artea's Backend.
I hope I was able to clarify your questions and doubts.
Please let me know if you need further support or have further questions on this topic.
Looking forward to hearing from you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
